title: SubstrateGap: posterior inconsistency audit: the arm's stored belief (thompson_alpha / (thompson_alpha + thompson_beta))
description: SubstrateGap: posterior inconsistency audit: the arm's stored belief (thompson_alpha / (thompson_alpha + thompson_beta)) disagrees with its own observed success rate (successful_executions / total_executions).
